sentences.text: The policy materials provided mention penal charges, if any, in case of delayed payment, but they do not state a late payment fee amount for credit card dues.
The UCB directions also say the policy shall clearly lay down liability by way of interest payments due to delays for non-compliance with the standards set by the UCB itself.
A separate UCB provision says credit card receivables are exempted from the APR-related provisions that follow in that section.

missing.searched: Reviewed the cited policy provisions on delayed-payment penal charges and the UCB directions on delay-related interest and APR treatment, but no specific credit-card late fee amount was found.
